case_title.quote: ACHHAR SINGH v. STATE OF HIMACHAL PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: The appellants Achhar Singh and Budhi Singh are aggrieved
number_of_accused.reason: Two appellants/accused before the Court (seven were charge-sheeted, but two convicted).

accused_gender.reason: Both appellants are male, as shown by names and 'his conviction'.

accused_age.reason: Age of accused is not stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation not stated; only 'farming community' generally.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No criminal record of the appellants is stated.

victim_gender.quote: Budhi Singh executed an axe blow on Swari Devi's head
victim_gender.reason: Deceased Swari Devi is female (Beli Ram, an injured male victim, also exists).

victim_age.quote: an old woman's vital body part
victim_age.reason: No specific age stated; only 'old woman'.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Budhi Singh described as neighbour; the argument mentions 'his neighbours'.

offence_category.correct_value: Murder (Budhi Singh); grievous hurt/simple hurt and house-trespass (Achhar Singh)
offence_category.quote: Achhar Singh has been convicted for offences under Sections 452, 326 and 323
offence_category.reason: Murder covers only one appellant; the other was convicted of hurt offences.

weapon.quote: Budhi Singh and Achhar Singh had axes
weapon.reason: Axes were the weapons used by the appellants.

evidence_type.quote: eye-witnesses have been able to see that the fatal blow ... medical evidence
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness and medical evidence relied upon.

trial_court_outcome.quote: The Additional Sessions Judge, Mandi acquitted all the accused

high_court_outcome.quote: set aside the acquittal of the appellants Achhar Singh and Budhi Singh

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are dismissed. ... convictions ... are maintained

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Murder and house-trespass (Budhi Singh); grievous and simple hurt and house-trespass (Achhar Singh)
offence_finally_established.quote: Budhi Singh's conviction under Sections 302 and 452 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Omits house-trespass (s.452) and simple hurt; roughly right otherwise.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Life imprisonment (Budhi Singh); fixed term of five years RI (Achhar Singh)
imprisonment_type.quote: Budhi Singh has been convicted for offences under Sections 302 and 452 IPC and sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life
imprisonment_type.reason: Fixed term applies only to Achhar Singh; Budhi Singh got life.

imprisonment_years.quote: sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for five years along with fine
imprisonment_years.reason: 5 years applies only to Achhar Singh.

fine_rs.reason: Fine amount not stated, so null is fine.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Prosecution case: accused shouted for complainant's family, pelted stones, broke the door, entered armed; Swari Devi was struck on the head and died; Beli Ram was hit and fainted.
neutral_facts.quote: Budhi Singh executed an axe blow on Swari Devi's head causing her death on the spot
neutral_facts.reason: Omits the death of Swari Devi and the pelting/door breaking; otherwise reveals no outcome.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced to undergo imprisonment for life along with fine
offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no statutory ranges; the given ranges are invented and wrong (s.302 is not 6 months–10 years).

attempt_completion.quote: causing her death on the spot

physical_harm.quote: incised wounds on the face and posterior skull along with fracture in the facial bone
physical_harm.reason: Matches death by head injury and Beli Ram's injuries.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Two appellants convicted: Budhi Singh of ss.302 and 452; Achhar Singh of ss.452, 326 and 323; trial charged ss.147, 148, 452, 506, 323, 302, 326.
number_of_offences.quote: committed to stand trial for offence under Sections 147, 148, 452, 506, 323, 302 and 326
number_of_offences.reason: Broadly right but it was the Supreme Court that maintained the convictions, and the value is vague.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial loss stated; only broken door and utensils.

motive.correct_value: Prior enmity, litigation and social boycott; Budhi Singh and Narinder Singh wanted to purchase the land on which complainant built his house.
motive.quote: Budhi Singh and Narinder Singh wanted to purchase the land where he had constructed a house
motive.reason: Judgment mentions prior enmity/land dispute as alleged motive.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: Consistent eyewitness testimony of PW1, PW11, PW12 that Budhi Singh gave the fatal axe blow and Achhar Singh attacked Beli Ram, corroborated by post-mortem and medical evidence.
key_evidence_accepted.quote: the allegation that Budhi Singh entered the house of the victims armed with an axe and hit Swari Devi on her head ... was consistent and undisputed
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Value is generic and does not name the actual evidence accepted.

witness_credibility.quote: the truth can be effortlessly extracted from their statements
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's assessment of the eyewitnesses.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of appellants stated.

bail_history.correct_value: Bail bonds of the appellants were cancelled
bail_history.reason: Judgment indicates the appellants were on bail, whose bonds were cancelled.

trial_duration.quote: judgment and order dated 12.05.2010/27.05.2010 ... Addl. Sessions Judge, Mandi dated 24.02.1998

legal_representation.correct_value: For appellants: J.S. Attri, R. Basant, Sr. Advs. and others; for respondent State: Abhinav Mukerji, AAG
legal_representation.quote: J.S. Attri, R. Basant, Sr. Advs., ... Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Names are correct but the judgment does not specify which counsel is for which appellant.

investigation_status.quote: the police after investigation found that only seven persons out of the lot were involved ... charge-sheet was filed

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Appellants alleged FIR delay and doubtful time of lodging; the Court rejected these as not fatal.
procedural_irregularity.quote: does not defeat the case of the prosecution as it is a minor contradiction
procedural_irregularity.reason: Judgment discusses alleged FIR delay but found no irregularity; 'None noted' omits this.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court acquitted; High Court set aside acquittal and convicted; Supreme Court dismissed appeals and upheld convictions.
appeal_history.reason: Substance is right, but 'conviction maintained' for the High Court is imprecise.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: State argued FIR is not substantive evidence, witness credibility is not affected by relationship or minor exaggerations, and inconsistent evidence against one accused cannot benefit another.
prosecution_argument.quote: inconsistent evidence by the prosecution witnesses against one accused cannot be capitalised to give the benefit of doubt to another
prosecution_argument.reason: Value attributes arguments not actually recorded as the State's contentions.

defence_argument.correct_value: Appellants argued a possible view by the trial court should not be disturbed, witnesses exaggerated, doubts on spot, axe recovery, FIR timing and time of death.
defence_argument.quote: so long as the trial Court's view was a 'possible view', further scrutiny by the High Court ... was not called for
defence_argument.reason: Captures the core argument but omits the specific factual contentions.

legal_principle_applied.quote: there is no bar on the High Court's power to re-appreciate evidence in an appeal against acquittal

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Murugesan, Aruvelu and Salim Akhtar were cited by the appellants; the Court relied on Gangadhar Behera, Hari Chand, Babu v. State of Kerala, Dalip Singh, Sarwan Singh, Chandrappa.
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Suffice it to cite Babu v. State of Kerala
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Lists mostly appellants' cited cases rather than those the Court relied on.

sentencing_rationale.reason: The Supreme Court gave no sentencing rationale; it only maintained convictions and sentences.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Court noted that an axe blow on an old woman's vital body part would probably cause death.
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: an axe blow on an old woman's vital body part would in all probability cause her death
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Not a formal aggravating factor, but the court noted this in convicting under s.302.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: The Supreme Court cancelled the bail bonds and directed the appellants to undergo the remainder of their sentence.
other_sentence_order.quote: Their bail bonds are cancelled and they are directed to undergo the remainder of their sentence.
other_sentence_order.reason: Order was by the Supreme Court, not the High Court.
